description: Sections of experimental shadow governance documents that the FORGE Governance Synchronizer may update during the evaluation period.
rules: The synchronizer may update only explicitly listed editable sections.
Any section not explicitly listed as editable is denied by default.
Human-controlled sections may be read for comparison but may not be modified.
The synchronizer may not create new editable section identifiers without explicit owner approval.
The synchronizer may not move content from a human-controlled section into an editable section.
All updates must be supported by captured repository or session evidence.
The synchronizer must stop without writing files when a requested update exceeds its granted authority.
